dedupe_keys.name: pvcracks solar cell damage and power loss models

description: PVCracks is a Sandia DuraMAT research repository for recognising cracks in silicon photovoltaic cell imagery and relating them to power loss. Its README describes segmentation of electroluminescence images, model-based feature representation and electrical datasets. Users supply cell images and measurements to the published analysis code; outputs include crack regions and estimated damage or loss indicators for those cells. Geographic coverage follows the cells sampled, not a national plant inventory. GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing for the code. The README links external DuraMAT DataHub resources and says a separate cell-level data publication is forthcoming, so data access and completeness must be checked there. A limitation is that laboratory cell cracks and imaging conditions do not directly determine field array output or lifetime. The model can help represent degradation in solar generation scenarios. The related catalogue ERA5 record is weather context, not PV condition data. No images, model weights or package were downloaded.
inputs: PV cell electroluminescence imagery and electrical measurements
name: PVCracks solar-cell damage and power-loss models
notes: G7 G7-1670. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. DuraMAT DataHub resources are external to this code repository; availability was not assumed.
